name: contextmd-monorepo
description: A local-first IDE for understanding, editing, and debugging AI agent context.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @contextmd/cli && npm run build -w @contextmd/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.web.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
